exposure: Policies to reduce cesarean section rates
cohort: 6,838,582 births at 28 completed weeks or more of gestation or birth weight ≥1000 g in 438 hospitals in the China's National Maternal Near Miss Surveillance System (NMNMSS)
finding: China successfully reduced cesarean section rates between 2012 and 2016 despite the relaxation of the one-child policy, which was associated with an increase in births that would typically have higher cesarean section rates.
